system.description:
Cunei Myrgha Inheritance: a business. Uncommon, Earth. No item slots.

Prerequisites: Society:Legalism[1], Wilderness:Flora[1], Proficiency[3]

You are a dedicated civil servant acquainted with agriculture

Influential (Ceremony): Every Long Rest that you take in your home city, you must spend at least one Long Rest action working for the Ministry. When you do, choose one effect:
Take Pay: Gain 50gp
Gain Influence: Gain 1 Influence with the Ministry of Agriculture or a Myrgha Oligarch

Agricultural Insights (Passive): When you use Wilderness:Flora regarding crops, you succeed even if you would fail.

Rulebook p.45.
